sloka: स ददर्श ततस्तस्या विवृतं सुमहन्मुखम् ।कायमात्रं च मेधावी मर्माणि च महाकपिः ॥५-१-१९१॥
transliteration: sa dadarśa tatastasyā vivṛtaṁ sumahanmukham ।kāyamātraṁ ca medhāvī marmāṇi ca mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-191॥

translations.english: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.
